Aadi Recipes - Chitra's Food Book
Skip to content
Aadi is the beginning of festival months for Tamil people. So Aadi pandigai is one of the famous festivals celebrated in Tamil nadu. In this month, we celebrate Aadi velli, Aadi sevvai, Aadi krithigai, Aadi amavasai, Aadi pooram and the most important Aadi perukku/Aadi 18 festival. In this page, I have shared the list of vegetarian Aadi masam recipes we make in this month for neivedyam and the celebration procedure for aadi 18 / Aadi perukku. Please click on the pictures to view the respective recipes. Happy Aadi!
